summary: A well presented two bedroom top floor apartment, ideally situated within this popular residential development in Northallerton. The property represents an excellent investment opportunity, being offered with a tenant already in situ currently paying £575 per calendar month.
description:
Accessed via a secure communal entrance with entry phone system, the apartment briefly comprises an entrance hall, spacious lounge/dining room, fitted kitchen, two bedrooms and a family bathroom. The property also benefits from well maintained communal gardens. Offered for sale with no onward chain, this property is ideally suited to investors seeking an established rental investment with a tenant already in occupation. Viewings are available immediately. Weavers Green is conveniently positioned for access to the amenities of Northallerton, a popular North Yorkshire market town offering a good range of shops, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants and everyday facilities. For those requiring transport links, Northallerton railway station is conveniently located for rail travel, with regular services and onward connections. The property offers a combination of two-bedroom accommodation, established rental income, convenient local amenities and excellent transport connections, making it an attractive proposition for both landlords and owner-occupiers alike.

ENTRANCE HALLWAY The welcoming entrance hall provides access to the accommodation and benefits from a radiator and useful loft access. The space provides a practical entrance to the apartment, with doors leading to the principal rooms.

LOUNGE /DINING ROOM The spacious lounge provides ample room for a range of furniture, including a comfortable seating area and dining table with chairs. The room benefits from a radiator and a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, providing plenty of natural light and creating a bright and welcoming living space.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a good range of base and wall-mounted units, complemented by laminate work surfaces and an inset stainless steel sink unit with drainer and mixer tap. Integrated appliances include an electric oven and hob, with plumbing provided for an automatic washing machine and space for a fridge/freezer. The room also benefits from a radiator and UPVC-framed double-glazed window, providing a good level of natural light.

BEDROOM ONE Bedroom One is a well-proportioned room offering a good range of built-in wardrobes, providing useful storage space. The room benefits from a radiator and UPVC-framed double-glazed window, creating a bright and comfortable bedroom.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom Two is a well-proportioned room benefiting from a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, allowing plenty of natural light into the room, together with a radiator providing warmth and comfort.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a modern white suite comprising a panelled bath with inset mains shower, wash hand basin set into a vanity unit and WC. The room features partially tiled walls and benefits from a radiator, providing a practical and comfortable bathroom space.

EXTERNALLY Externally, the property benefits from well-maintained communal garden areas, providing attractive outdoor space for residents to enjoy. The apartment also benefits from allocated parking, offering convenient off-road parking for the property.
